basis: Uses the repository formal scorecard weights. Scores are conservative participant-side quality estimates after deterministic gate, spatial review, visual packaging, professional evidence review, and PDF rendering QA all pass.

gate_evidence.pdf_render_qa: A0 5 pages and A3 12 pages rendered with no blank pages, black blocks, obvious clipping, or map overflow in sampled review.

evidence: proposal.md covers all 13 required sections
one-spine-three-courts-two-wings structure responds to three-level scope and three key areas
tracks and scenarios metadata match the open-call categories
remaining_deductions: Official redline and final design brief attachments remain unavailable, so some spatial claims must stay provisional.

evidence: Public Value Passport is an original governance object attached to spatial interventions
geodesic visual language defines proprietary color, line, legend, and evidence-at-edge rules
case references are translated as mechanisms rather than copied as images or style
remaining_deductions: Originality would be stronger with site-survey-based micro-spatial prototypes and public workshop evidence.

rubric.dimension_zh: AI 与城市规划创新性
evidence: Algorithmic rules are overlaid onto lines, polygons, nodes, and phases instead of isolated flowcharts
AI+ scenarios include data contracts, human review, non-digital alternatives, event response, and retirement conditions
NIST-style govern-map-measure-manage logic is translated into civic space and operation gates
remaining_deductions: No live simulation, agent prototype, or measured post-occupancy feedback is available at competition stage.

evidence: Eight delivery projects are classified by owner type, partner, prerequisite, CAPEX/OPEX band, KPI, and stop condition
Three phases use G0-G4 gates from evidence lock to reversible retain/modify/remove decision
Unknown controls are deliberately not fabricated
remaining_deductions: Implementation cannot score 5 without official ownership, cost, traffic, utility, fire-safety, and approval-path confirmation.

evidence: Personas cover researchers, developers, students, residents, older people, operators, and international visitors
Every high-impact AI scenario requires human review and a non-digital service path
The public ground, accessibility, complaint, and rollback rules are represented in both text and drawings
remaining_deductions: Public-benefit claims are design assumptions until resident and stakeholder participation data are collected.

evidence: Provisional geometry is clearly labeled and never upgraded to official status
Copyright statement identifies original assets, CC-BY-SA-4.0 sharing, OSM attribution, and no reuse of case imagery
AI governance forbids automatic material decisions and requires audit, incident logging, and rollback
remaining_deductions: Actual data-processing agreements and legal review are future prerequisites.

evidence: A0 begins with a dominant overall masterplan and includes three key-area deepening, algorithm overlay, and implementation gates
A3 booklet, proposal HTML, static visual page, GeoJSON, metrics, manifest, and bilingual companions are synchronized
Metrics are kept as evidence rails and do not dominate the spatial drawings
remaining_deductions: Some drawing details remain diagrammatic rather than survey-accurate; English companion is an executive companion rather than full line-by-line translation.

critical_remaining_risks_before_95_plus: Replace provisional boundary and key-area polygons with official CAD/GIS geometry.
Add measured street, building, utility, tree, heat, flow, ownership, and fire-safety baselines.
Convert diagrammatic key-area prototypes into dimensioned survey-backed plans and sections.
Add stakeholder/public participation evidence and a real operations budget.
Provide a full professional English translation if the final judging context requires equal bilingual depth.
